shortfallReason: 7 complete annual periods are available after reviewing annual and initial IPO or operating-predecessor filings. Earlier quarterly summaries or the SPAC shell are not substituted for comparable annual company financial statements.
shortfallReasonZh: 已查阅年度和首次上市或经营前身申报，共有7个完整年度。不会用更早的季度摘要或SPAC空壳数据代替可比公司年度财务报表。
